trust_boundaries.name: Perimeter / Ingress Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Boundary between untrusted external clients/browsers and FastAPI HTTP ingress
controls: Sliding-window rate limiting with bounded history table (max 10000 entries)
Early request payload size bounding (max 1 MB / HTTP 413)
Security response headers (nosniff, DENY, no-referrer, CSP, conditional HSTS)

trust_boundaries.name: Application Services Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Boundary between serving layer and authoritative triage pipeline
controls: Pydantic strict schema validation (extra='forbid', max record limits)
Ground truth label leakage prevention (FORBIDDEN_LABEL_KEYS guard)
Authoritative Phase 8 deterministic reasoning isolated from LLM output

trust_boundaries.name: Internal Assets & Providers Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Boundary safeguarding local filesystem, telemetry storage, and LLM providers
controls: PathValidator strict root containment (data/, results/, configs/)
Rejection of directory traversal tokens (.., %2e%2e, absolute escapes)
Redaction of Authorization headers and sensitive keys from logs and traces

assets.name: API Credentials
assets.protection: Zero-secrets policy, constant-time verification, no logging

assets.name: Model & Calibration Artifacts
assets.protection: Read-only access, deterministic pipeline execution, strict root validation

assets.name: Frozen Evaluation Benchmarks
assets.protection: Rule 1 & Rule 88 immutability protection, results/phase12 integrity

assets.name: System Logs & Evidence
assets.protection: Treated strictly as untrusted text, no shell or SQL execution, prompt quotation sandboxing

assets.name: Telemetry & Observability
assets.protection: Sanitized Prometheus metrics, bounded cardinality, zero secret exposition

threat_actors.name: Unauthenticated Internet Client
threat_actors.capabilities: Network scanning, DoS flooding, unauthenticated probe attacks

threat_actors.name: Malicious Authenticated User
threat_actors.capabilities: Privilege escalation attempts, diagnostic access, rate limit evasion

threat_actors.name: Adversarial Log Injector
threat_actors.capabilities: Embedded prompt injection, HTML/XSS injection, system command strings in logs

threat_actors.name: Path Traversal Attacker
threat_actors.capabilities: Injecting ../ or absolute paths to read .env or system credentials
